sources.title: Investor Bulletin: An Introduction to Options

stable_locators: Basic Options Terminology > premium paragraph beginning 'The amount of the premium'

limitations: U.S. educational bulletin; exact Indian index-option applicability must be verified from current NSE/Dhan contract truth.

sources.title: Understanding Options Greeks
stable_locators: Main article > opening paragraph
Main article > pricing input list
limitations: Greeks are theoretical sensitivities, not exact realized premium changes.
contradictions: A Greek value alone does not validate direction, liquidity, costs, or outcome probability.

sources.title: Support for Resistance: Technical Analysis and Intraday Exchange Rates
sources.author_organisation: Carol L. Osler; Federal Reserve Bank of New York
stable_locators: PDF p.53 > opening definition
PDF p.64 > Conclusion
PDF p.64 > reported strength ratings conclusion
limitations: 1996-1998 intraday FX sample; transfer to Indian index options requires CITADEL validation.

sources.title: Currency Orders and Exchange-Rate Dynamics: Explaining the Success of Technical Analysis
sources.author_organisation: Carol L. Osler; Federal Reserve Bank of New York
stable_locators: Abstract > two familiar predictions
Abstract > order clustering and round numbers
limitations: Single-bank FX order data; does not establish universal institutional causality.
contradictions: CITADEL has no authoritative stop-order book and must not infer hidden orders from candles alone.

sources.title: Foundations of Technical Analysis: Computational Algorithms, Statistical Inference, and Empirical Implementation
sources.author_organisation: Andrew W. Lo, Harry Mamaysky, Jiang Wang; National Bureau of Economic Research
stable_locators: Abstract > subjectivity and systematic recognition
Abstract > incremental information finding
limitations: Daily U.S. equity sample ending 1996; patterns and results do not transfer automatically to intraday Indian options.
contradictions: Subjective visual naming is not acceptable without a deterministic predicate and new OOS evidence.

sources.title: The Price Impact of Order Book Events
sources.author_organisation: Rama Cont, Arseniy Kukanov, Sasha Stoikov
stable_locators: Abstract
Section 2.3 > Model specification
Section 4.1 > Trade imbalance vs order flow imbalance
Section 5 > Conclusion
limitations: NYSE TAQ top-of-book study; CITADEL currently lacks authoritative L2/order-event history for production use.
contradictions: Trade volume alone was noisier and less robust than full order-flow imbalance in the studied data.

sources.title: Statistical Overfitting and Backtest Performance
sources.author_organisation: David H. Bailey, Stephanie Ger, Marcos Lopez de Prado, Alexander Sim, Kesheng Wu
stable_locators: PDF p.1 > Abstract
PDF pp.3-5 > Backtest overfitting in finance and investments

limitations: Illustrative research does not define CITADEL promotion thresholds.
contradictions: A hold-out split alone does not control repeated trials or guarantee generalization.

sources.title: Amendments to Regulation 4.41(b): Advertising by Commodity Pool Operators, Commodity Trading Advisors, and the Principals Thereof
stable_locators: Regulation 4.41 proposed disclaimer > hypothetical performance limitations
